description.value: Urban Liquor Store is a privately-owned Kelowna liquor store that positions itself as a community hub, with staff including WSET Advanced-certified and Cicerone-trained specialists who focus on local BC craft beer, wine, spirits, and cider. Founded in 2015 and led by a WSET Sommelier owner, the shop emphasises quality craft products and sustainability alongside a loyalty program and event services. Delivery is available within 8 km of the store, and online ordering is offered for customers further afield.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website content is fully available and provides the authoritative source. A critical address discrepancy exists: OSM places the store at 1973 Harvey Avenue (V1Y 6G5) while the website consistently shows 1191 Gordon Drive, Kelowna, BC V1Y 3E5 across every page including the dedicated contact page — I use the website address and flag the mismatch. The website and its subpages make no mention of bike parking, washrooms, water refill, or any cyclist-oriented amenities, so all such fields are null.
concerns: Address mismatch: OSM has '1973 Harvey Avenue, Kelowna, V1Y 6G5' but the website consistently shows '1191 Gordon Drive, Kelowna, BC V1Y 3E5' across all pages including the contact page. These are two different streets and postcodes.
URL was discovered at medium confidence only — the address mismatch raises the possibility this website belongs to a different location or a relocated business not yet updated in OSM.

Website navigation shows a logged-in GoDaddy placeholder account ('filler@godaddy.com'), suggesting the site was built from a GoDaddy template; this is a minor cosmetic concern, not a closure indicator.
OSM record has no phone number; phone sourced from website only.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: The OSM address (1973 Harvey Avenue, V1Y 6G5) does not match the website address (1191 Gordon Drive, V1Y 3E5) — these are distinct locations, suggesting either a mis-geocoded OSM node or an incorrect URL match (URL discovery confidence was only 'medium'). The address discrepancy must be resolved before listing to avoid directing cyclists to the wrong location.
